lines.text: In the house of the LORD, Hananiah said God had broken Babylon's yoke and would restore exiles within two years.
Jeremiah said "Amen," then told Hananiah a prophet of peace is recognized only if his word comes true.
Hananiah broke the yoke from Zedekiah's neck, saying God would break Babylon's yoke within two years.
The LORD told Jeremiah that Hananiah broke a yoke of wood but made a yoke of bronze in its place.
Jeremiah told Hananiah he would die that year, and Hananiah died in the seventh month.
